question: A told to B, "I am your paternal uncle. C is my paternal uncle's son and X is my wife". B told A, "Y is my paternal grandmother and you are her youngest son". How is X related to Y?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) A told to B, "I am your paternal uncle. C is my paternal uncle's son and X is my wife".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d54455df019623258f7fc44f04d6076c7f978f2c5a16928ebdc32cfac926ded1.png] 

2) B told A, "Y is my paternal grandmother and you are her youngest son".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f32c89e2e1dbbc6181dfb7867cfed9d683d3e55b6aa7d9be1cf97a2ec0a3c02.png] 

Thus, X is Y's daughter-in-law or son's wife.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
